Messages.Author: Death
Messages.Body:
Just a quick question about Sabine Lafitte, the Tremere 5 blood vampire:

Does her special ability (During untap you may transfer 1 blood from
Sabine to any other Tremere in the game) mean that she can transfer blood
to Uncontrolled Tremere in my inactive region?

Thanks!

- Ashwath

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. Uncontrolled vampires are not "in the game" (normally called "in
play") and cannot be affected by any effect unless card text explcitly
allows it.
